package oci

import (
	\"bytes\"
	\"context\"
	\"fmt\"
	\"path/filepath\"
	\"testing\"
	\"time\"

	\"github.com/opencontainers/go-digest\"
	v1 \"github.com/opencontainers/image-spec/specs-go/v1\"
	\"github.com/stretchr/testify/require\"
	\"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/config\"
	fliptoci \"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/oci\"
	\"go.uber.org/zap/zaptest\"
	\"oras.land/oras-go/v2\"
	\"oras.land/oras-go/v2/content/oci\"
)

func TestSourceRefreshesLocalRepository(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	dir := t.TempDir()
	path := filepath.Join(dir, \"flags\")
	publish := func(key string) {
		t.Helper()
		layout, err := oci.New(path)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		layout.AutoSaveIndex = true
		payload := fmt.Sprintf(\"flags:\\n  - key: %s\\n    name: %s\\n    enabled: true\\n\", key, key)
		layer := v1.Descriptor{
			MediaType: fliptoci.MediaTypeFliptNamespace + \"+yaml\",
			Digest: digest.FromString(payload), Size: int64(len(payload)),
			Annotations: map[string]string{fliptoci.AnnotationFliptNamespace: \"team\"},
		}
		require.NoError(t, layout.Push(ctx, layer, bytes.NewReader([]byte(payload))))
		manifest, err := oras.PackManifest(ctx, layout, oras.PackManifestVersion1_1_RC4, fliptoci.MediaTypeFliptFeatures, oras.PackManifestOptions{Layers: []v1.Descriptor{layer}})
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.NoError(t, layout.Tag(ctx, manifest, \"latest\"))
	}
	publish(\"first\")
	store, err := fliptoci.NewStore(&config.OCI{BundleDirectory: dir, Repository: \"flipt://local/flags:latest\"})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	source, err := NewSource(zaptest.NewLogger(t), store, WithPollInterval(10*time.Millisecond))
	require.NoError(t, err)

	first, err := source.Get(ctx)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	_, err = first.GetFlag(ctx, \"team\", \"first\")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	cached, err := source.Get(ctx)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Same(t, first, cached)

	publish(\"second\")
	second, err := source.Get(ctx)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotSame(t, first, second)
	_, err = second.GetFlag(ctx, \"team\", \"second\")
	require.NoError(t, err)
}

func TestSourceSubscribeSendsOnlyChanges(t *testing.T) {
	// The local refresh test exercises the digest cache. This test checks that
	// cancellation closes the subscription even without another manifest.
	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
	dir := t.TempDir()
	store, err := fliptoci.NewStore(&config.OCI{BundleDirectory: dir, Repository: \"flipt://local/flags:latest\"})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	source, err := NewSource(zaptest.NewLogger(t), store, WithPollInterval(time.Millisecond))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	ch := make(chan *storagefs.StoreSnapshot)
	go source.Subscribe(ctx, ch)
	cancel()
	select {
	case _, ok := <-ch:
		require.False(t, ok)
	case <-time.After(time.Second):
		t.Fatal(\"subscription did not stop\")
	}
}
EOF

			store = sqlite.NewStore(db, builder, logger)
		case fliptsql.Postgres, fliptsql.CockroachDB:
			store = postgres.NewStore(db, builder, logger)
		case fliptsql.MySQL:
			store = mysql.NewStore(db, builder, logger)
		default:
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported driver: %s", driver)
		}

		logger.Debug("database driver configured", zap.Stringer("driver", driver))
	case config.GitStorageType:
		opts := []containers.Option[git.Source]{
			git.WithRef(cfg.Storage.Git.Ref),
			git.WithPollInterval(cfg.Storage.Git.PollInterval),
		}

		auth := cfg.Storage.Git.Authentication
		switch {
		case auth.BasicAuth != nil:
			opts = append(opts, git.WithAuth(&http.BasicAuth{
				Username: auth.BasicAuth.Username,
				Password: auth.BasicAuth.Password,
			}))

item.text:
Added OCI-backed feature flag storage in [source.go](/app/internal/storage/fs/oci/source.go) and connected it to the gRPC storage configuration. Local OCI layouts are reopened on each fetch so external tag changes are visible; digest checks reuse unchanged snapshots, and subscriptions publish only changed snapshots. I also made `SnapshotSource.Get` context-aware and carried OCI layer namespace annotations into snapshot parsing.

Verified with the OCI, filesystem, command, and config tests, plus `git diff --check`.
